name: ui-review help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:ui-review. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Reopen
entries.text: Puts a decided item back in the waiting list.

entries.title: Waiting
entries.text: Items still waiting for your decision.

entries.title: Screens list
entries.text: Shows or hides the list of screens beside the pictures.

entries.title: Previous screen
entries.text: The picture of the screen before this one.

entries.title: Next screen
entries.text: The picture of the next screen.

entries.title: Previous screen, every column
entries.text: Steps every column back one screen together, so phone and desktop stay lined up.

entries.title: Next screen, every column
entries.text: Steps every column on one screen together, so phone and desktop stay lined up.

entries.title: Re-capture
entries.text: Takes this screenshot again from the live app and replaces the picture that failed to load.

entries.title: Wait for my look approval before UI builds start
entries.text: On: a build that changes UI waits in UI Review until you approve its predicted look; Reject holds it. Off: it starts straight away.

entries.title: More
entries.text: Part of the predicted mockup: stands in for the screen's More menu. It does nothing here.

entries.title: Ring my phone when UI Review waits too long
entries.text: When an item sits unreviewed for the review window, your phone rings a loud alarm and the banner shows it. Off = items just wait.

entries.title: When the alarm isn't answered
entries.text: What happens when the alarm rings and nobody taps it within the grace: Auto-approve (run it) or Don't run it (leave it waiting). Auto-approvals are logged and can be undone.

entries.title: Review window
entries.text: How long an item can wait unreviewed before the alarm rings (default 30 min).

entries.title: Grace after the alarm
entries.text: How long after the alarm the switch acts (default 5 min). Tapping the alarm stops the countdown.

entries.title: Applies to
entries.text: Every item, or only items with a PR or branch (the ones holding a merge).

entries.title: Open UI Review on each new item
entries.text: A new item opens UI Review on it (with Follow Amber on) and sends your phone a notice.

entries.title: Alarm sound
entries.text: Where you set “Alarm sound”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Alarm volume
entries.text: Slide to set “Alarm volume”: left is less, right is more. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Vibrate
entries.text: Turns “Vibrate” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Keep ringing until I tap it
entries.text: Turns “Keep ringing until I tap it” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Quiet hours
entries.text: Turns “Quiet hours” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: From
entries.text: Where you set “From”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: During quiet hours
entries.text: Where you set “During quiet hours”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Save time zone
entries.text: Saves time zone. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Pin waiting items on top
entries.text: Where you set “Pin waiting items on top”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Stop the alarm (I'm on it)
entries.text: Stops the alarm (I'm on it). Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Undo auto-approval
entries.text: Undos auto-approval. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: PR # only
entries.text: Shows “PR # only”. Part of UI Review.
